summary: Iteration 5: Gallery (Emergent Object Storage) + blink-twice hero animation tested end-to-end. Backend: all 13 pytest cases PASS (upload success, auth 401, empty file 400, GET file returns image bytes with image/* content-type, delete works, list reflects deletion, plus regression on settings/slots/heartbeat/online/stats). Frontend: home renders with 2.500 RSD price pill, yellow flash overlay div (backgroundColor #FFF6C2 / rgb(255,246,194)) is mounted with pointerEvents='none' — animation completes and opacity returns to 0 after mount (blink-twice via Animated confirmed structurally). 'Naši radovi' section correctly HIDDEN when gallery is empty. Admin login with 'puzopb' works, all 5 tabs present (Zahtevi, Termini, Statistika, Galerija, Podešavanja), Galerija tab shows caption input + pick/upload button + empty grid. No page errors. Two minor React Native Web deprecation warnings observed (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Migrate to 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/admin.tsx (styles.fab shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).
React Native Web deprecation: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx line 104 (Animated.View pointerEvents="none").

action_items: (Optional / low-priority) Migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow in admin.tsx styles.fab to silence RN Web deprecation.
(Optional / low-priority) Move pointerEvents='none' from prop to style on the flash Animated.View on the home hero (index.tsx line ~104).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_gallery_file uses a regex match on storage_path suffix which is fine for uuid filenames but would be fragile if uploads shared filenames — currently safe because uuid4 + extension.
Backend correctly retries once when storage returns 503 (stale key) — good resilience.
Frontend correctly hides 'Naši radovi' when gallery.length === 0 (verified visually).
seed_data_creation: Test uploaded and cleaned up its own tiny PNG images via /api/admin/gallery. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Emergent Object Storage integration works end-to-end from this test environment: PUT /objects/... succeeds, and GET via /api/gallery/files/{filename} returns proper image bytes with image/* Content-Type. Admin password is 'puzopb'. Two RN Web deprecation warnings are cosmetic only.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features work as intended.
